Hello sir, the orders in the pickup section had a timer running on them but now do not see the timer. So do I pick them up right now or do I pick them up after the scheduled maintenance? Will the timer reset? And when will I receive my pending amount in my balance?

Dear Merchant,  We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience.  Please be informed that the system will undergo a refresh/update to ensure that merchants can continue receiving new orders and operate smoothly and hassle-free.  During this process, the timer for all awaiting orders will be reset, and a new 48-hour timer will begin. Please note that the order history may not be available after the system refresh, while any pending amounts will be added to your balance shortly.  We kindly request you to remain patient while the system refresh is being completed. Everything will be updated accordingly, allowing you to continue managing your orders smoothly.  Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.  Regards, Team TikTok Seller Center

Hello Sir, one more thing, the awaiting pickup orders do not show the timer anymore, so I will not pickup any orders until the timer has come and been updated. So, will not picking up these orders affect my credit score and rating rate until the timer has come?

Dear Merchant,  Please be assured that your rating rate/credit score will not be affected as long as you continue to process and pick up your orders within the designated timeframe.  Your rating or credit score may only be affected if you fail to pick up an order after the order timer has started and the order remains unprocessed beyond the specified timeframe.  Thank you for your cooperation and continued commitment.  Regards, Team TikTok Seller Center

Your days will only be counted when the maintenance has been completed and you start picking up orders. However, your 4th day will still be counted, but the 5th day will be counted after the maintenance is completed and you pickup orders again.

faqs.title: How to process customer orders?
faqs.content: Go to the Order tab, locate orders waiting for pickup, and tap 'Click to Pickup' to proceed with dispatch.

faqs.title: When will my wallet earnings settle?
faqs.content: Order profits move from Pending Balance to Available Balance once the buyer confirms delivery or within 7 business days.

faqs.title: How do I top up my store account?
faqs.content: Use the Recharge button on the Home tab to deposit via USDT TRC20 transfer.

faqs.title: How to withdraw funds to my account?
faqs.content: Tap Withdrawal on the Home tab, enter your withdrawal amount and payout details, and submit for instant review.
